identity.title: [v0.91.7][tooling][CI] Keep mixed Runtime v3 and CSM validation out of Runtime v2 coverage

review_prompts: Can an unrelated mixed-crate change enter the bounded route?
Does each changed crate execute its own tests?
Can coverage omit one crate while still reporting success?
Are Runtime v2 tests excluded by construction?

findings.summary: The committed review metadata changed HEAD without an exact non-substantive proof.

residual_risk: Hosted CI remains the final proof that the focused llvm-cov route interoperates with the GitHub runner toolchain.
